2. EEE363- Nqh teaching 3/10, exams mostly from the book, memorize proofs. Curving: 1 grade, lab e Sir dhuye den
3. Pol101-Tmn, miss is an absolute sweetheart, no nonsense type of teacher, quizzes: mcq, fill in the blanks, true false, mid and final part1: mcq, t/f, f/b; part2: 1 open ended bro… See more

Mdy lmao but ar option o nai
Sir last e onek curve kore
Mid motamoti doable que korleo final tough korse ebr

Kno problems hbena
1. EEE361 bhaloi hard course jodi apni maths r basics na janen but Mahdy Sir bhaloi bujhae r onk curve koren. But don’t leave this course for the last semester as kharap onkei kore retake lagte pare but cheshta korben 1st time ei bhalo korte as course ta khali Mahdy Sir e nen.
2. 342 korar age Mehrab Likhon bhaiya recommend koren 321 korar so ota age korle bhalo
3. 363 bhaloi jhamelar course onnano shb uni teh eta 2ta course but nsu teh akta machines Aqu Sir better porae onar kache korar cheshta korben Nqh easier questions korleo will not recommend.

4. 312 onk pora ei course tae Mfy Sir matha ultae diben r lab o bhaloi tricky
5. 362 easiest in the list of courses given by you. Hzr Sir r kache korle uni exactly same question koren every year numbers o change korena assignments o same thake. Bhalo na korle skill issue honestly, Sir khali theory poran but exam e khali math den maths gula onk lengthy porikha r ager raat pore exam deyar course na but easiest. Lab onk shoja Mehrab bhaiya ke instructor hishabe paile apnar jibon set. Try taking under Hzr kichu na shikhleo grade ta paben but Sir curve monehoi korenna cause onkei full marks pai.

First 3-4 ta class mone hbe sir onk cool curve korbe, quiz nibe kom nicee. Then quiz-1 diye kanna korben. Then mid diye vabben more kn jai na. Then every class er last e kanna korben. Still jodi apni every lecture follow kore note nite paren. Onnnk onnk onnk concentrate kore lecture bujhen, sir er boi ta theke poren, ager jei class note sir dibe oigula poren. Then A/A- pete paren. But MDY apnake eita at least bujhaye dbe je electrical engineering kn one of the hardest engineering. Peace
Shb lecture note koren. Lecture bujhle r exam er age note vlo mto dekhlei A-/A pawa jai. Mdy is an excellent faculty. I really miss his class. Theoretical beshi, tai effort o beshi dte hbe.
Arpita Raha ja poraye ta valomoto bujha lagbe topics, unar question dhore ans korte parlei curve korle valo grade aisha porbe unar kache.
